campaign.title: W=Y^(7/16) post-inner numerator/outer-ray bilinear gate

resource_policy.literature_policy: No external theorem is assumed. Consult a source only for an exact bilinear or large-sieve inequality whose hypotheses match the literal determinant kernel and actual characters.

frozen_target.question: After the Round-129 K_rho/L inner reciprocal/lift theorem, can one obtain a genuine signed contraction across the remaining reduced-numerator increments and/or outer rays, or does the exact outer dual, phase alignment, or unit-Hessian geometry force a capacity self-return?
frozen_target.reference_formula: For one half-open B-shell, O_(i,B)^+=sum_(r=(a,b)) A_i(r)e(ca/(kappa_i b)) F_i(r), where F_i(r)=sum_(a') sum_(rho|a') sum_(eta) S_(i,r,a',rho,eta), and every S retains its exact threshold/plateau formula. Accepted bounds are sup|A_i|<<L^(-1)Y^epsilon, sum_r|A_i(r)|^2<<D/L Y^epsilon, #r<<LD, #a'<<L, and |S|<<K_B/L Y^epsilon. Outside triangles give D K_B=Y^(35/48), while target is D=Y^(1/2). Test a direct bilinear estimate or the target-scale outer energy sum_r|F_i(r)|^2<<LD Y^epsilon without replacing the actual coefficients by an arbitrary matrix family.
quantities: current complete block D K_B=Y^(35/48+epsilon), target D=Y^(1/2+epsilon), missing factor K_B=Y^(11/48)
outer ray energy sum|A_i|^2<<D/L and pointwise scale L^(-1) are exact actual-coefficient facts
a'=a+p lies in O(L) literal increments, with determinant taper, M1/M2 characters, Mobius divisors, threshold data, and shell owners retained
a strict fixed-power saving is bankable, but no global pointwise improvement follows until the complete correlation exponent drops below 9/16

completion_criteria: Write the exact post-inner M1/M2 bilinear sum before either the a'-triangle or outer-ray triangle, preserving both outer and inner complete-lift coefficients, centre phases, determinant taper, threshold representation, and character placement.
Derive the exact dual or Gram form of the proposed outer energy and test whether it is equivalent to a stronger positive norm rather than the scalar signed target.
Construct a phase-aligned and coefficient-blind false control at the same support and energy scales; identify the exact physical property required to exclude it.
Attack the a'=a+p sum jointly with the reciprocal variable, including every product-window resonance and M1/M2 quarter-character orientation, before taking a modulus.
Audit the known unit-Hessian two-dimensional transform return and show precisely whether the proposed mechanism is noninvertible or merely another canonical self-return.
Charge Mobius progressions, strict/weak/star faces, threshold equalities, numerator support exits, cross-shell owners, and the equal-ray diagonal exactly once.
Either prove a complete target-scale outer inequality, prove a strict fixed-power saving with exact first residual, or establish the smallest rigorous no-go and park this interface.
Do not infer a global exponent improvement unless the complete fixed-block correlation exponent is below 9/16; make no M9 or quarter promotion.

tasks.target: Compute the exact outer dual/Gram implied by the supplied post-inner bilinear statement. Prove the proposed target-scale outer energy, give a support-matched phase-aligned countermodel, or state the sharp additional actual-family property required.
excluded_context: all Round-95 through Round-130 nonblind artifacts
required_output: An exact dual/Gram calculation and support-matched control.
A proof, minimal repaired inequality, or rigorous no-go.

tasks.target: Recombine the exact a'=a+p increments with the reciprocal variable before modulus. Prove a target or strict saving beyond D K_B, or isolate the first exact product-window or character-alias return, while retaining the Round-129 threshold theorem inside the joint expression.
required_output: The exact p-v-threshold formula before every outside modulus.
A target theorem, strict saving plus first residual, or exact self-return/no-go.

tasks.target: Hostilely test every proposed post-inner outer contraction against actual character placement, phase alignment, positive-energy strengthening, product-window resonances, unit-Hessian return, and exact owners. Certify only a literal scalar gain.
required_output: A seam matrix and exact aligned or resonance control.
Certification, strict scope restriction, or rigorous no-go.

review_seams.requirement: Both complete ray coefficients, the a' increments, every threshold, the determinant taper, and all phases are written before an outer norm.
The exact dual or Gram of every proposed outer energy is computed, and a stronger positive norm is not confused with the scalar target.
Actual M1/M2 characters and Mobius congruences remain in their literal variables until any claimed cancellation is obtained.
Product-window near integers, phase-aligned controls, and every two-dimensional stationary alias are priced.
Threshold equality, support exits, stars, diagonal, and half-open shells are charged once.
Every proposed norm displays its exact power relative to current D K_B, target D, and the 9/16 global-improvement threshold.
